name: 浅茂川浦島温泉
sales_point: 小浜海水浴場の西方に位置する温泉地。夏は多くの海水浴客で賑わいを見せる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers unique cave onsens with ocean views and a wide variety of buffet dishes, including fresh tuna and unlimited alcohol. They also highlight the friendly staff and the overall relaxing and enjoyable experience.

Some reviews mention the building can be old and poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located west of Obama Beach, bustling with many beachgoers in summer.

name: 天橋立温泉
sales_point: 日本三景の一つに数えられる「天橋立」に新しく湧出した温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、観光の拠点としても好適。
sales_point_en: A newly emerged hot spring area near 'Amanohashidate', one of Japan's three scenic views. Blessed with a natural environment, it is also suitable as a base for tourism.

name: 嵐山温泉
sales_point: 嵐山の北側山麓、保津川の河畔に位置する温泉地。自然環境が良く、旅の疲れを癒すのには最適。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers a relaxing experience with multiple indoor and outdoor hot spring baths, a sauna, and cold plunge pools. They also highlight the clean facilities, including well-maintained restrooms and showers with provided toiletries. Guests mention the friendly and helpful staff, who assist with entry and provide tattoo covers for a fee.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of the northern side of Arashiyama, along the banks of the Hozu River. It has a good natural environment, perfect for relieving travel fatigue.

name: 嵐山嵯峨野温泉
sales_point: 嵐山の観光名所、渡月橋付近の一軒宿の温泉地。風光明媚で、閑静な環境。
review_summary: People say this bathhouse offers a wide variety of baths, including natural hot springs, saunas, and cold plunges, with many different benefits and features. Visitors also highlight the clean facilities, delicious food at the in-house restaurant, and reasonable prices. They also mention the helpful and friendly staff, as well as the convenient and ample parking.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area near the famous tourist spot, Togetsukyo Bridge in Arashiyama. Scenic and tranquil environment.

name: 岩滝温泉
location: 京都府 与謝郡与謝野町
sales_point: 内海の阿蘇海に面した岩滝海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。天橋立や丹後観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Iwataki coast facing the Aso Sea. Ideal as a base for visiting Amanohashidate and Tango.

name: おおみや小町温泉
sales_point: 小野小町ゆかりの里、大宮町に位置する温泉地。夜は降り注ぐような星空を仰ぎながら入浴できる。美人づくりの湯とも言われており人気がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Oomiya Town, associated with the poet Ono no Komachi. You can enjoy bathing under a starry sky at night. Known as a beauty-enhancing hot spring, it is quite popular.

name: 奥橋立伊根温泉
location: 京都府 与謝郡伊根町
sales_point: 丹後半島の東端、海と山に囲まれた閑静な環境に位置する温泉地。京都府下最大の湯量を誇る。日帰り入浴も好評。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious crab and鰤 shabu-shabu, along with a smooth alkaline hot spring with stunning ocean views. They also highlight the attentive staff and the comfortable, renovated rooms.

Some reviews mention the public bath can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a quiet environment surrounded by the sea and mountains at the eastern tip of the Tango Peninsula. It boasts the largest hot spring water volume in Kyoto Prefecture. Day-use bathing is also well-received.

name: 笠置温泉
location: 京都府 相楽郡笠置町
sales_point: 笠置山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。木津川を望む風光明媚な環境にある。春の桜、秋の紅葉は見事。釣り、ボート等も楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this campground offers a wide, free site where you can park your vehicle next to your tent, and it's very affordable for day or overnight stays. They also highlight the helpful staff, well-maintained facilities, and convenient trash disposal.

Some reviews mention the other campers can be impolite.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Kasagiyama. It offers a scenic view overlooking the Kizugawa River. The cherry blossoms in spring and the autumn leaves are magnificent. Fishing and boating can also be enjoyed.

name: かすみ（久美の浜温泉郷）
sales_point: 久美浜湾の北西部、湊大橋の近くに位置する温泉地。果物は春から秋に、冬はカキで楽しませてくれる。久美の浜温泉郷のひとつで、国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious open-air baths with waterfalls and natural rock formations, as well as hot indoor baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices, delicious food, and relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northwest part of Kumihama Bay, near Minato Ohashi. Enjoy fruits from spring to autumn and oysters in winter. One of the Kumi no Hama hot spring areas, designated as a national health resort.

name: 北白川天然ラジウム温泉
sales_point: 比叡山の麓に位置する温泉地。ラジウム含有量が高いと言われる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Hiei. It is said to have a high radium content.

name: 木津温泉
sales_point: 僧行基の発見と伝えられる温泉地。1200年の歴史を誇り、丹後最古の温泉と言われる。のどかな田園に囲まれた閑静な環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area believed to have been discovered by the monk Gyoki. It boasts a history of 1200 years and is said to be the oldest hot spring in Tango. Located in a quiet environment surrounded by peaceful countryside, it is suitable for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 久美浜（久美の浜温泉郷）
sales_point: 久美の浜温泉郷の中心となる温泉地。久見浜湾の西部に位置し、眺望が良い。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious open-air baths with waterfalls and natural rock formations, as well as hot indoor baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices, delicious food, and relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
sales_point_en: The central hot spring area of Kumi no Hama Onsen District. Located in the western part of Kumihama Bay, it offers a good view. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 久美浜シーサイド（久美の浜温泉郷）
sales_point: 久美浜町の北西部に位置する温泉地。カキ筏が浮かぶ久美浜湾を目前にして眺望が良い。マリンスポーツも楽しめる。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious open-air baths with waterfalls and natural rock formations, as well as hot indoor baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices, delicious food, and relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
name_en: Kumihama Seaside (Kumi no Hama Onsen District)
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northwest part of Kumihama Town. It offers a good view of Kumihama Bay with oyster rafts floating nearby. Marine sports can also be enjoyed. Designated as a national health resort.

name: くらま温泉
sales_point: 北山杉に囲まれた静かな山里・鞍馬に位置する温泉地。檜造りの露天風呂が人気。森林浴と温泉浴を同時に楽しめる。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a relaxing outdoor bath with stunning mountain and forest views, along with an indoor area featuring hot and cold baths and a sauna. They also highlight the delicious and reasonably priced food at the restaurant, including local specialties like wild boar hot pot and Kyoto-style udon. Guests mention the friendly and helpful staff, who often provide English explanations and free shuttle service from the station.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the quiet mountain village of Kurama, surrounded by Kitayama cedar. The wooden open-air bath is popular. Enjoy both forest bathing and hot spring bathing.

name: 地蔵谷温泉
sales_point: 北白川から比叡山に向かう途中の地蔵谷の山中に位置する温泉地。ラドンの含有量が高いと言われる。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers delicious, simple dishes made with natural radium water, including fresh sashimi on weekends and flavorful hot pot. They also highlight the soft, warming radium spring water, which is beneficial for health, and the option to relax and nap in the tranquil resting area. Guests mention the friendly and welcoming staff, who create a nostalgic, home-like atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains of Jizodani on the way from Kitashirakawa to Mount Hiei. It is said to have a high radon content.

name: 神野（久美の浜温泉郷）
sales_point: 久美の浜海岸地区に位置する温泉地。自然に恵まれた素晴らしい環境で保養向き。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious open-air baths with waterfalls and natural rock formations, as well as hot indoor baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices, delicious food, and relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Kumihama coastal area. It has a wonderful environment blessed by nature, suitable for recuperation. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 丹後温泉
sales_point: 丹後半島最北端の丹後町の中心部に位置する温泉地。奥退治伝説で知られ、周囲が約1キロもある立岩が目の前。夏は海水浴客で賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the center of Tango Town at the northernmost tip of the Tango Peninsula. Known for the legend of Okutaiji, with a standing rock about 1 kilometer in circumference right in front. Bustling with beachgoers in summer.

name: 丹後奥伊根温泉
location: 京都府 与謝郡伊根町
sales_point: 日本海を眼下に望む眺望の良い温泉地。雄大なロケーションと日本海の幸を堪能できる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious crab and鰤 shabu-shabu, along with a smooth alkaline hot spring with stunning ocean views. They also highlight the attentive staff and the comfortable, renovated rooms.

Some reviews mention the public bath can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with a good view overlooking the Sea of Japan. Enjoy the magnificent location and the seafood from the Japan Sea.

name: 丹後琴引温泉
sales_point: 若狭湾国定公園の琴引浜に位置する温泉地。歩くと「キュッ、キュッ」と不思議な音が鳴る「鳴き砂」で知られる。夏は海水浴客で賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on Kotobiki Beach in the Wakasawan National Park. Known for its 'singing sand' that makes a mysterious sound when walked on. Bustling with beachgoers in summer.

name: 平田（久美の浜温泉郷）
sales_point: 京都府の北西端の久美浜町北東部に位置する温泉地。久美の浜温泉郷の一角。一帯が山陰海岸国立公園に指定され、風光明媚な環境にある。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious open-air baths with waterfalls and natural rock formations, as well as hot indoor baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices, delicious food, and relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northeastern part of Kumihama Town, at the northwestern tip of Kyoto Prefecture. Part of the Kumi no Hama Onsen District. The entire area is designated as part of the San'in Kaigan National Park, offering a scenic environment. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 宮津羽衣温泉
sales_point: 日本三景の一つ、天橋立が一望できる高台に位置する温泉地。周辺では海水浴や釣りなどが楽しめる。風光明媚な環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on a high point with a panoramic view of Amanohashidate, one of Japan's three scenic views. Enjoy activities like swimming and fishing in the surrounding area, all in a picturesque environment.

name: 夢絃峡温泉
location: 京都府 相楽郡南山城村
sales_point: 月ヶ瀬口駅の南西1キロ、伊賀川と名張川の合流点に位置する温泉地。各部屋から四季の美しい眺望を堪能できる。水と緑と静けさが、ゆったりとした最高の気分を与えてくれる。
sales_point_en: Located 1 kilometer southwest of Tsukigaseguchi Station, this hot spring is at the confluence of the Iga and Nabari rivers. Each room offers beautiful seasonal views, providing a serene atmosphere filled with water, greenery, and tranquility.

name: 安鳥温泉
sales_point: 日吉町中心の北東約５キロに位置する温泉地。日吉青年山の家の中にあり、バンガローがある。町の名産みぶなは京野菜の一種で通年味わえる。車で約10分の所に近畿でも最大規模のダム、日吉ダムがある。このダムは日本で初めて提体内を見学できるダムとして有名。ダムの北方には日帰り入浴施設があり、南方には府民のキャンプ場がある。
review_summary:
Guests mention the resort offers delicious and reasonably priced meals, including diverse options like hot pot and gibier, with many highlighting the fluffy dashi-rolled omelets. They also appreciate the warm service, well-maintained facilities, and the option to rent barbecue equipment and buy meat on-site.

Other reviews mention the baths can be small.
sales_point_en: Situated about 5 kilometers northeast of Hiyoshi Town, this hot spring is within the Hiyoshi Youth Mountain House and features bungalows. The town is known for its specialty, Mibuna, a type of Kyoto vegetable available year-round. Nearby is Hiyoshi Dam, one of the largest in the Kinki region, famous for being the first dam in Japan to allow visitors to tour its interior.

name: 夕日ヶ浦温泉
sales_point: 山陰海岸国立公園中の景勝地、夕日ヶ浦海岸に位置する温泉地。白砂青松の浜が約8キロに渡って続き、日本海の落陽の眺めが特に美しく圧巻。冬のカニとブリも美味。
sales_point_en: Located in the scenic Yuhigaura Coast within the San'in Kaigan National Park, this hot spring features an 8-kilometer stretch of white sandy beaches and pine trees, offering stunning views of the sunset over the Japan Sea. Winter delicacies like crab and yellowtail are also a highlight.

name: 湯の花温泉
sales_point: 山峡の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。戦国時代に武士が傷を癒したと伝えられ、歴史が永い。閑静な環境。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located along a mountain stream in a tranquil valley. It is said that samurai healed their wounds here during the Sengoku period, giving it a long historical significance.

name: 由良浜温泉
sales_point: 三庄太夫ゆかりの地、若狭湾の由良浜に面した温泉地。海水浴場が近く、白砂青松の地にある。夏季は海水浴客で賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring facing the Yurahama beach in Wakasa Bay, known for its connection to the famous Sanjo Dayu. The nearby beach is popular for swimming, especially during the summer months.

name: るり渓高原温泉
sales_point: 兵庫県、大阪府に隣接した園部町南部、園部川沿いに位置する温泉地。ラドン含有量が多いことで知られる。閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this facility offers a wide variety of indoor and outdoor play areas for children, including pools and athletic equipment, and features clean, well-maintained facilities. They also highlight the delicious food at reasonable prices, the relaxing atmosphere, and the helpful staff.

Other reviews mention it can be extremely crowded.
sales_point_en: Located in the southern part of Sonobe Town, adjacent to Hyogo and Osaka Prefectures, this hot spring is known for its high radon content. It offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation, and is recognized as a national health resort.

name: レイクフォレストリゾート温泉
location: 京都府 相楽郡南山城村
sales_point: 三重・志賀・奈良県に隣接した南山城村に位置する温泉地。サッカー、テニス、ゴルフ、カヌーなど総合スポーツ施設も充実しており、家族連れにも最適。
sales_point_en: Situated in Minamiyamashiro Village, adjacent to Mie, Shiga, and Nara Prefectures, this hot spring features comprehensive sports facilities for soccer, tennis, golf, and canoeing, making it perfect for families.

name: 赤穂御崎温泉
sales_point: 瀬戸内海を一望できる岬の高台に位置する温泉地。近くに御崎、福浦、東福浦海水浴場があり、夏は海水浴客で賑わう。赤穂義士にちなんだ名所が多い。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers stunning ocean views from its infinity-style open-air baths and guest rooms, providing a relaxing and immersive experience. They also highlight the delicious and generous meals, especially the fresh seafood and seasonal dishes. Guests mention the staff are friendly, attentive, and provide excellent service, making for a memorable stay.
sales_point_en: Perched on a high point overlooking the Seto Inland Sea, this hot spring is close to Misaki, Fukura, and Higashifukura beaches, bustling with visitors during the summer. It is also known for its many historical sites related to the Ako Gishi.

name: 有馬温泉
spa_quality: 含鉄泉、単純温泉、二酸化炭素泉、炭酸水素塩泉、塩化物泉、硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 神戸市の北部、六甲山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。鎌倉時代に仁西上人が12の宿坊を建てたことから坊のつく宿が多い。豊臣秀吉が愛した温泉地。
spa_quality_en: Iron Spring, Simple Spring, Carbon Dioxide Spring, Bicarbonate Spring, Chloride Spring, Sulfate Spring
sales_point_en: Located in the northern part of Kobe City, on the northern foothills of Mount Rokko, this hot spring has a rich history dating back to the Kamakura period when monk Ninsei built 12 lodges. It is a favorite hot spring of Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

name: 粟鹿温泉
sales_point: 粟鹿山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。四方を山に囲まれており、緑豊かで閑静な環境。登山、ハイキングの基地にも良い。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers a relaxing experience with smooth, skin-softening water and delicious local cuisine, including gibier dishes like wild boar hot pot and deer cutlets. They also highlight the clean facilities, friendly staff, and the option to pay with credit cards.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be small.
sales_point_en: Nestled on the northern foothills of Mount Awagaka, this hot spring is surrounded by mountains, offering a lush and quiet environment, making it a great base for hiking and climbing.

name: 淡路島一宮温泉
sales_point: 海抜100メートルの海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。お湯は弱アルカリ性で肌が美しくなる。
sales_point_en: Located along the coast at an elevation of 100 meters, this hot spring features mildly alkaline water that is said to beautify the skin.

name: 生谷温泉
sales_point: 黒尾山南側山麓の伊沢川河畔に位置する温泉地。四季折々に姿を変える豊かな自然を満喫できる。
review_summary:
People say this inn offers delicious, healthy meals featuring local ingredients and fermented foods, with generous portions for both dinner and breakfast. Guests also highlight the spacious, clean rooms with beautiful views, and the relaxing large public baths with saunas and open-air options.

Other reviews mention the service can be inefficient.
sales_point_en: Situated along the Izawa River at the southern foothills of Mount Kuroo, this hot spring allows visitors to enjoy the rich nature that changes with the seasons.

name: 石道温泉
sales_point: 野尻川沿いに位置した温泉地。自然環境に恵まれている。川西市の奥座敷として親しまれている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a variety of baths, including a unique reddish-brown, thick outdoor hot spring, and a wide selection of delicious food options like "botan nabe." They also highlight the affordable meal and bath sets, and the overall relaxing, retro atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located along the Nojiri River and is blessed with a rich natural environment, cherished as the hidden retreat of Kawanishi City.

name: 出石温泉
sales_point: 但馬の小京都と呼ばれる出石町中心部に位置する温泉地。出石城跡や古寺など名所も多い。「美人の湯」と呼ばれ親しまれている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has excellent quality hot spring water that leaves skin feeling soft and smooth, and the indoor baths are spacious. They also highlight the reasonable 500-yen entry fee and the helpful staff.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be closed.
sales_point_en: Located in the center of Izushi Town, known as the small Kyoto of Tajima, this hot spring is surrounded by many historical sites, including the ruins of Izushi Castle and ancient temples. It is affectionately referred to as the 'Beauty Hot Spring.'

name: 猪名川温泉
location: 兵庫県 川辺郡猪名川町
sales_point: 一本松山北東に位置するおんせんち。猪名川河畔にあり、冬にはマス釣りを楽しむ釣り人で賑わう。秋の味覚の松茸、栗が名産。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located northeast of Ippommatsu Mountain, along the Inagawa River, bustling with anglers during winter for trout fishing. The area is also known for its autumn delicacies, including matsutake mushrooms and chestnuts.

name: 岩屋温泉
sales_point: 淡路町の田ノ代海岸に位置する温泉地。海岸では海水浴や釣りなどを楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located on the Tanoshida Coast in Awaji Town, this hot spring offers opportunities for swimming and fishing along the coast.

name: うずしお温泉
location: 兵庫県 南あわじ市
sales_point: 淡路島の南端、西淡町に位置する温泉地。鳴門海峡に面した漁村で大鳴門橋の眺めがよい。美人湯として人気がある。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious multi-course meals featuring fresh local seafood like fugu and various tai dishes, with generous portions. They also highlight the smooth, skin-softening onsen water, scenic views, and attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the service can be inefficient.
sales_point_en: Situated at the southern tip of Awaji Island in Nishiwaki Town, this hot spring is in a fishing village facing the Naruto Strait, offering great views of the Ohnaruto Bridge. It is popular for its beautifying waters.

name: 歌長温泉
location: 兵庫県 美方郡新温泉町
sales_point: 湯村温泉の東方、歌長に位置する温泉地。宿はカナダから直輸入材料で仕上げたログハウスで緑豊かな丘の上にある。
sales_point_en: Located east of Yumura Onsen in Utanaga, this hot spring features lodgings made from materials imported directly from Canada, set on a lush green hill.

name: 大笹温泉
location: 兵庫県 美方郡香美町
sales_point: 野間峠の東方に位置する温泉地。近畿地方には少ないラジウムの多い泉質で、保養・療養に好適。ハチ北高原スキー場に隣接しており、夏は登山客、冬はスキー客で賑わう。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen has a unique, thick, and gentle water quality that leaves skin smooth and warm, and they appreciate the radon mist shower. They also highlight the clean facilities, the welcoming staff, and the restaurant with various food options.

Other reviews mention the air conditioning can be insufficient.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located east of Noma Pass and is known for its radium-rich waters, which are rare in the Kinki region, making it suitable for health and recuperation. It is adjacent to the Hachikita Highland Ski Resort, bustling with hikers in summer and skiers in winter.

name: 大沢温泉
sales_point: 六甲山系北側の緑豊かな田園地帯に湧く温泉地。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen features a relaxing open-air bath with water quality similar to Arima Onsen's Kinsen, and a variety of indoor baths. They also highlight the attentive and helpful staff, and appreciate the JAF discount.

Other reviews mention the price can be high.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the lush rural landscape on the northern side of the Rokko Mountain Range.

name: 小代温泉
location: 兵庫県 美方郡香美町
sales_point: 矢田川の支流、久須部川河畔に位置する温泉地。山あいにあり、自然環境に恵まれている。登山客にも好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area situated along the banks of the Kusube River, a tributary of the Yatagawa River. Nestled in the mountains, it is blessed with a rich natural environment, popular among hikers.

name: 加古川温泉
sales_point: 加古川畔の丘に位置する温泉地。周辺に果樹園やゴルフ場等がある。一年を通して行楽客や家族連れで賑わう。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers a variety of baths, including a unique iron-rich "golden" spring similar to Arima Onsen, and a refreshing open-air bath. They also highlight the affordable entry fee and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a hill by the Kakogawa River, surrounded by orchards and golf courses. It is bustling with visitors and families year-round.

name: 籠坊温泉
sales_point: 武庫川支流の羽束川沿いに位置する温泉地。標高400メートルの山峡にあり、平家の落武者の伝説が残る。自然環境に恵まれている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Hasukagawa River, a tributary of the Mukogawa River. Situated in a mountain gorge at an elevation of 400 meters, it is rich in natural beauty and steeped in legends of the Heike clan.

name: 笠井温泉せせらぎ
location: 兵庫県 神崎郡市川町
sales_point: 市川町の東部山あいに位置する温泉地。湯治向きの宿で、自炊やバーベキューもできる。美人の湯として知られる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers a variety of baths, including a warm indoor bath and two outdoor baths with varying temperatures, and many appreciate the smooth, soft water. They also highlight the delicious local food and desserts, the well-maintained facilities, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the eastern mountainous region of Ichikawa Town. Known for its healing properties, it offers self-catering and barbecue facilities.

name: 香住温泉
location: 兵庫県 美方郡香美町
sales_point: 山陰随一の景勝地で知られる香住海岸を望む温泉地。海水浴や観光基地として最適。冬場のカニが人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area overlooking the scenic Kasumi Coast, known as one of the best scenic spots in the San'in region. Ideal for beach activities and tourism, especially popular for winter crab.

name: 鹿の子温泉
sales_point: 六甲山北麓のなだらかな丘陵地に位置する静かな温泉地。鹿ノ子池畔にある。
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area located on gentle hills at the northern foot of the Rokko Mountains, by the shores of Kanoko Pond.

name: 神鍋温泉
sales_point: 神鍋山の山麓に位置する温泉地。自然を満喫した後に温泉を楽しめる環境にある。冬はスキーが楽しめる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen features a variety of baths, including jet baths, a cold plunge, and a spacious outdoor bath, along with a hot sauna. They also highlight the clean facilities, reasonable prices, and available discounts with a lift ticket or hotel room key.

Other reviews mention it can be extremely crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Kanabe, where you can enjoy the hot springs after immersing yourself in nature. Skiing is also available in winter.

name: 城崎温泉
sales_point: 円山川の支流大渓川沿いに位置する温泉地。レトロ調の街なみの中にある。6ヶ所の外湯めぐりが好評。古寺、仏閣、玄武洞など見所も多く、情緒深い温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Odaikawa River, a tributary of the Maruyama River. Known for its retro-style townscape and popular for its six public baths. Rich in cultural sites like ancient temples and the Genbudo Cave.

name: 久崎温泉
location: 兵庫県 佐用郡佐用町
sales_point: 秋里川と佐用川が合流する付近に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養・静養に好適。
review_summary:
Visitors praise this onsen for its clean facilities and spacious indoor bath, with some noting a discount on the entrance fee.

Other reviews mention the baths can be lukewarm and the outdoor baths can be closed.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the confluence of the Akisato River and the Sayou River. It offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 国領温泉
sales_point: 黒頭峰北側山麓に位置する温泉地。四方を山に囲まれた静かな環境で、保養・静養に好適。鯉料理、ぼたん鍋などが味わえる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a unique reddish-brown "Kinsen" hot spring, similar to Arima Onsen, with a comfortable, slightly cooler temperature perfect for long soaks. They also highlight the reasonable 700 yen day-use fee and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere.

Some reviews mention there can be a strong chlorine smell in the indoor baths.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northern foot of the Kurotou Peak, surrounded by mountains. It is a peaceful environment suitable for recuperation, offering local delicacies like carp dishes and botan nabe.

name: 小島温泉
sales_point: 日和山温泉の南方、円山川河口近くに位置する温泉地。地元で獲れる海の幸が美味。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located south of Hiyoriyama Onsen, near the mouth of the Maruyama River. Known for its delicious local seafood.

name: 佐津温泉
location: 兵庫県 美方郡香美町
sales_point: 香住町の北東部、山陰海岸沿いの佐津に位置する温泉地。海、川、山に囲まれ自然豊か。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northeastern part of Kami Town, along the San'in Coast. Surrounded by the sea, rivers, and mountains, it is rich in natural beauty.

name: 塩田温泉
sales_point: 夢前川沿いに位置する温泉地。桜並木が美しく、のどかな環境。姫路の奥座敷と言われている。胃腸に効能が高いとされている。
review_summary: Guests mention this ryokan offers delicious, voluminous meals, including unique dishes like spring water congee and freshly ground coffee. They also highlight the exceptional service, with staff providing thoughtful gestures like extra yukata and personalized assistance. Visitors appreciate the tranquil, traditional Japanese atmosphere and the well-maintained, clean rooms, some with private open-air baths.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yumesaki River, known for its beautiful cherry blossom trees and tranquil environment. Often referred to as the hidden retreat of Himeji, it is said to be effective for digestive health.

name: 七釜（浜坂温泉郷）
location: 兵庫県 美方郡新温泉町
sales_point: 浜坂温泉郷のひとつ。岸田川河畔ののどかな田園地帯の中に小さな宿が点在する。国民保養温泉地に指定され保養・療養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features excellent, free-flowing hot spring water with a slightly cloudy, yellowish-brown appearance, and offers both indoor and open-air baths. They also highlight the clean facilities, reasonable 700 yen adult admission, and convenient location near the highway exit.

Some reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: One of the Hamasaka Onsen Districts, featuring small inns scattered in a peaceful rural area along the Kishida River. Designated as a national health resort, it is ideal for recuperation and therapy.

name: 柴山温泉
location: 兵庫県 美方郡香美町
sales_point: 柴山港の目前、国道178号線沿いに位置する温泉地。香住海岸探訪基地に好適。港で獲れた魚介類が好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located right in front of Shibayama Port, along National Route 178. It serves as a great base for exploring the Kasumi Coast, with fresh seafood from the port being highly praised.

name: 下谷上温泉
sales_point: 神戸市の北西部に位置する温泉地。総合福祉施設。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring facility features a wide variety of natural hot spring baths, including spacious outdoor garden baths, and offers diverse saunas and four types of bedrock baths. They also highlight the delicious and high-quality meals available at the on-site restaurant, with many appreciating the reasonable prices. Guests mention the facility is clean, well-maintained, and provides excellent service from the staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northwest part of Kobe City, part of a comprehensive welfare facility.

name: 十戸温泉
sales_point: 日高町の十戸地区に位置する温泉地。清水が湧き虹鱒の養殖が盛ん。大岡山の登山や釣りも楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Jukkyo district of Hidaka Town, known for its clear spring water and thriving rainbow trout farming. Enjoy hiking on Mount Ooka and fishing.

name: 杉生温泉
location: 兵庫県 川辺郡猪名川町
sales_point: 杉生地区にある青少年の活動施設として使われている温泉地。テニスなどもできる。大野山ハイキングの拠点に好適。秋の味覚の松茸、栗が名産。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Sugio district, used as a youth activity facility. It offers tennis and serves as a great base for hiking on Mount Ono. Known for seasonal delicacies like matsutake mushrooms and chestnuts.

name: 須磨温泉
sales_point: 古くは須摩霊泉と呼ばれていた。須摩浦に近い風光明媚な温泉地。
sales_point_en: Historically known as Suma Reisen, this scenic hot spring area is close to Sumaura.

name: 洲本温泉
sales_point: 淡路島の東岸に位置する温泉地。紀淡海峡や大阪湾の眺望が良い。大浜海岸へも近く、観光や海水浴の拠点に好適。葉も料理が名物。
sales_point_en: Located on the eastern coast of Awaji Island, it offers great views of the Kida Strait and Osaka Bay. Close to Ohama Beach, it is ideal for tourism and seaside activities, with local cuisine being a specialty.

name: 太山寺温泉
sales_point: 色々な大学が集まった学園都市駅の北方、伸川沿いに位置する温泉地。神戸観光や、淡路島方面へ行くのにも便利。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a rare radium hot spring that leaves skin smooth and warm, offers a relaxing atmosphere, and provides a free shuttle bus from the nearest station.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be neglected and service can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: Situated along the Shin River, north of the educational city station where various universities gather, this hot spring is convenient for Kobe sightseeing and trips to Awaji Island.

name: 宝塚温泉
sales_point: 宝塚市街地の武庫川沿いに位置する温泉地。奈良時代の開湯と伝えられ、歴史が永い。宝塚大劇場を中心に娯楽施設が整っている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot springs, including "golden spring" baths similar to Arima Onsen, and a variety of saunas. They also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and convenient free shuttle bus service.

Some reviews mention the golden hot spring baths can be small and crowded.
sales_point_en: Located along the Mukogawa River in the city center, this hot spring is said to have been established in the Nara period, boasting a long history. It is surrounded by entertainment facilities centered around the Takarazuka Grand Theater.

name: 竹田温泉
sales_point: 山陰随一の桜の名所「立雲峡」の麓、円山川右岸に位置する温泉地。対岸には国史跡・竹田城跡の眺望が素晴らしい。
review_summary: Visitors say this castle ruin offers stunning views of the surrounding mountains and well-preserved, impressive stone walls, often compared to Machu Picchu. They also highlight the unique experience of seeing the "sea of clouds" during the autumn and early winter mornings. Guests mention the well-maintained paths and the option to take a bus or taxi for part of the ascent, making it accessible for many.
sales_point_en: Located at the foot of the famous cherry blossom spot 'Ritsukyu Gorge' on the right bank of the Maruyama River, it offers stunning views of the historic Takeda Castle ruins across the river.

name: 武田尾温泉
sales_point: 武庫川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。新緑や紅葉の頃は特に美しく、渓谷美を楽しむ人々で賑わう。鮎釣りもできる。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is situated along the Mukogawa Gorge, particularly beautiful during the fresh green and autumn foliage seasons, attracting many visitors who enjoy the gorge's beauty. Ayu fishing is also available.

name: 竹野温泉
sales_point: 但馬海岸に位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on the Tajima coast.

name: ちくさ高原温泉
sales_point: 岡山県境に近いちくさ高原に位置する温泉地。光と緑に包まれた高原リゾート。冬はスキーが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Nestled in the Chikusa Highlands near the Okayama Prefecture border, this hot spring is a resort surrounded by light and greenery, with skiing available in winter.

name: 東条温泉
sales_point: ひょうご東条ICから約5分のところに位置し、車の便がよい温泉地。7種類のお風呂やサウナがあり、効能も高い。近郊の人々の療養・保養場としても親しまれている。
sales_point_en: Located about 5 minutes from the Hyogo Tojo IC, this hot spring is easily accessible by car. It features seven types of baths and saunas, known for their high efficacy, and is popular as a healing and recuperation spot for locals.

name: 中間温泉
sales_point: 藤無山北側山麓、大屋川のほとりに位置する温泉地。兵庫県最大の滝、天龍や横行渓谷方面への探勝、鮎釣り等の拠点に好適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor options, jacuzzis, and saunas. Guests also highlight the reasonable 700 yen admission fee, clean facilities, and relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Situated at the foot of Fujimuna Mountain, along the Oya River, this hot spring is a great base for exploring the largest waterfall in Hyogo Prefecture, Tenryu, and the Yokokou Gorge, as well as for Ayu fishing.

name: 長井温泉
location: 兵庫県 美方郡香美町
sales_point: 三川山北側山麓の矢田川沿いに位置する温泉地。久斗山登山や周辺ハイキング基地の好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers enjoyable free-flowing hot springs, including both indoor and outdoor baths, and features a relaxing bedrock bath. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices and the clean resting areas.

Other reviews mention the outdoor baths can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: Located along the Yata River at the foot of Mikawa Mountain, this hot spring is a great base for climbing Mount Kuto and hiking in the surrounding area.

name: 南淡温泉
location: 兵庫県 南あわじ市
sales_point: 瀬戸内海国立公園の中に位置する温泉地。鳴門海峡、福良湾を見下ろす高台にある。潮干狩り、釣り、キャンプなど四季を通じて楽しめる温泉リゾート。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers a wide variety of delicious local dishes, including fresh seafood and Awaji Island onions, and features a renovated buffet restaurant. Guests also highlight the stunning ocean views from the rooms and open-air baths, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the buffet food can be cold.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located within the Setonaikai National Park, perched on a hill overlooking the Naruto Strait and Fukura Bay. It is a year-round resort for clam digging, fishing, and camping.

name: 西脇温泉
sales_point: 日本のヘソ、西脇市を南北に走る国道427号線沿いに位置する温泉地。四季折々の趣や大地の息吹を感じられる温泉。
sales_point_en: Located along National Route 427, which runs north and south through Nishiwaki City, known as the 'belly button' of Japan, this hot spring allows visitors to experience the beauty of the changing seasons and the breath of the earth.

name: 波賀温泉
sales_point: 氷ノ山後山那岐山国定公園の原生林に囲まれた温泉地。揖保川の支流、八丈川の渓流沿いに位置する。国道29号線を北上し音水湖を越えるとスキー場も点在しており、冬はスキー基地としても好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers a relaxing natural setting with a wide variety of delicious food, including impressive dinner and breakfast options. They also highlight the clean facilities, spacious rooms, and the soothing radon hot spring.

Some reviews mention the hot springs can be cold.
sales_point_en: Surrounded by the primeval forest of the Hyono Mountain and Naki Mountain National Park, this hot spring is located along the Hachijo River, a tributary of the Ibo River. It is also a suitable base for skiing in winter, with ski resorts scattered beyond Lake Onmizu.

name: 浜坂（浜坂温泉郷）
location: 兵庫県 美方郡新温泉町
sales_point: 山陰海岸国立公園内に位置する温泉地。浜坂温泉郷の中心で、宿泊施設はもちろん、一般家庭にも温泉が引かれている。国民保養温泉地に指定され保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located within the San'in Kaigan National Park, this hot spring is at the center of the Hamasaka Onsen district, with accommodations and hot springs available even in private homes. It is designated as a national health resort, ideal for recuperation.

name: 日和山温泉
sales_point: 奇岩怪石の豪快な風景が続く日和山海岸の近くに位置する温泉地。山陰国立公園の一角にあり、円山川で舟遊びも楽しめる。本場山陰の松葉ガニなども味わえる。
review_summary: Visitors say this scenic spot offers stunning views of the coast, including a unique island with a building resembling a dragon palace. They also highlight the beautiful sunsets, recommending an evening visit. Others mention it's conveniently located next to the marine park.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located near the Hiyoriyama coast, known for its dramatic rock formations. Situated in a corner of the San'in National Park, visitors can also enjoy boat rides on the Maruyama River and taste the local Matsuba crab.

name: 広田温泉
location: 兵庫県 南あわじ市
sales_point: 県立淡路ふれあい公園の東側に位置する温泉地。見晴らしの良い山の上にあり、辺りの山々を眺望できる。バドミントンやバスケットもでき、美しい花々が迎えてくれる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor rotenburo, and a sauna. They also highlight the affordable entry fees and the relaxing atmosphere, making it a great place to unwind.

Other reviews mention the facility can be neglected.
sales_point_en: Located on the east side of the Awaji Prefectural Fureai Park, this hot spring is situated on a hill with great views of the surrounding mountains. Visitors can enjoy badminton and basketball, welcomed by beautiful flowers.

name: 二日市（浜坂温泉郷）
location: 兵庫県 美方郡新温泉町
sales_point: 浜坂温泉郷の一角。田園風景の中に位置する温泉地。国民宿舎や病院などに配湯されている。国民保養温泉地に指定され保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Part of the Hamasaka Onsen district, this hot spring is located in a rural landscape. It is supplied to national lodges and hospitals, designated as a national health resort, ideal for recuperation.

name: やしろ夢園温泉
sales_point: 三草山の西側山麓、千鳥川河畔に位置する温泉地。御影石の一枚岩で造られた天然風呂や舞台付大広間のある数寄屋造りの宿が好評。菊まつりや三草山登山に最適。
sales_point_en: Located at the foot of Mikusa Mountain, along the Chidori River, this hot spring features natural baths made from a single piece of granite and a traditional-style inn with a stage, popular among visitors. It is ideal for the Chrysanthemum Festival and climbing Mount Mikusa.

name: 養父温泉
sales_point: 国道9号線沿いの道の駅「但馬楽座」に隣接した温泉地。山と川に囲まれた自然豊かな環境にある。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor options, jacuzzis, and saunas. Guests also highlight the reasonable 700 yen admission fee, clean facilities, and relaxing atmosphere.

Other reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Adjacent to the roadside station 'Tajima Rakuzan' along National Route 9, this hot spring is surrounded by mountains and rivers in a rich natural environment.

name: 湯村温泉
location: 兵庫県 美方郡新温泉町
sales_point: 春来川沿いに位置する温泉地。慈覚大師が848年に発見したと伝えられる歴史ある名湯。「荒湯」と呼ばれる源泉は98℃で湯量豊富。「夢千代日記」の舞台となった温泉地。
sales_point_en: A historic hot spring area located along the Haruka River, believed to have been discovered by the monk Jikaku Daishi in 848. The source known as 'Arayu' has a temperature of 98°C and abundant water supply. It is also the setting for the novel 'Yumechiyo Nikki'.

name: 朝来温泉
location: 和歌山県 西牟婁郡上富田町
sales_point: ＪＲ朝来駅近くに位置する温泉地。新鮮な魚貝類を味わうことができ、近くにはゴルフ場もある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near JR Asaka Station, where you can enjoy fresh seafood and nearby golf courses.

name: 有田川温泉
sales_point: 有田川の川辺を一望できる温泉地。ゆっくりくつろぐことができる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious meals, including fresh ayu dishes and hearty kue, with options for breakfast and dinner. They also highlight the adjacent hot spring facility, which is accessible to guests and features a relaxing onsen.

Other reviews mention the hotel can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with a panoramic view of the Aritagawa River, perfect for relaxing.

name: 有田温泉
sales_point: 湯浅湾を望む断崖に位置する温泉地。紀伊水道の眺望が良く、付近の岩場は磯釣りによい。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including alternating hot and cool tubs, and two types of saunas. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, delicious food, and extensive manga collection in the rest area.

Other reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a cliff overlooking Yuasa Bay, offering great views of the Kii Channel, with nearby rocky areas ideal for fishing.

name: 市江崎温泉
location: 和歌山県 西牟婁郡白浜町
sales_point: 市江湾に面した温泉地。太平洋を眺望できる風光明媚な環境。特に夕陽が美しい。海釣りや海水浴、磯遊びが楽しめる。
review_summary: People say this open-air hot spring offers spectacular ocean views, with some pools feeling almost integrated with the sea, and features multiple tubs with varying temperatures and a distinct sulfur scent. Visitors also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee and the friendly, helpful staff. They also appreciate the convenient, free parking and the simple, natural atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing Ichie Bay, set in a picturesque environment with views of the Pacific Ocean, especially beautiful at sunset. Enjoy sea fishing, swimming, and tide pooling.

name: 大谷温泉
location: 和歌山県 有田郡有田川町
sales_point: 有田川の北岸、千葉山の山裾に位置する温泉地。みかん畑に囲まれた山村風景の中にある。四季折々の山海の幸を味わうことが出来る。高速道路に近くアクセスが便利。
sales_point_en: Located on the north bank of the Aritagawa River, at the foot of Chibayama, this hot spring area is surrounded by mandarin orchards in a rural mountain landscape. Enjoy seasonal mountain and sea delicacies, with convenient access to the highway.

name: 加太温泉
location: 和歌山県 和歌山市
sales_point: 和歌山市の北西端に位置する温泉地。海岸沿いにあり、加太湾を望む風光明媚な環境。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northwest tip of Wakayama City, along the coast with scenic views of Kada Bay.

name: 勝浦温泉
location: 和歌山県 東牟婁郡那智勝浦町
sales_point: 紀伊半島東南部の海沿いに位置する温泉地。大小の島々が浮かぶ紀ノ松島など風光明媚な地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the southeastern coast of the Kii Peninsula, known for its beautiful scenery with numerous islands, including Kinomatsushima.

name: 川湯（熊野本宮温泉郷）
sales_point: 大塔川の川底から湯が湧く温泉地。川原を掘って自分専用の露天風呂が楽しめる。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: People say this outdoor hot spring offers a unique experience with varying water temperatures, allowing visitors to find their preferred warmth. They also highlight the free admission, convenient free parking, and available changing rooms. Guests mention the stunning night sky views and the option to dig personal hot spring pools in the riverbed.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area where hot water springs from the riverbed of the Oto River. You can dig in the riverbed to enjoy your own private outdoor bath. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 紀伊見温泉
sales_point: 紀見峠の東側に位置する温泉地。金剛生駒紀泉国定公園内にあり、豊かな緑に包まれている。美人の湯としても親しまれている。
review_summary:
People say this inn offers a wide variety of all-you-can-drink options, including alcohol and soft drinks, and delicious meals with generous portions. They also highlight the smooth, thick, and comfortable alkaline hot spring water, and the friendly, helpful staff.

Other reviews mention staff communication can be difficult.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the eastern side of Kimi Pass, nestled within the Kongo Ikoma Kisen National Park, surrounded by lush greenery. Known as a beauty hot spring.

name: 紀見温泉
sales_point: 紀見峠の南方に位置する温泉地。国道371号線沿いにあり、観光、行楽、通勤帰りにも好評。
review_summary:
People say this inn offers a wide variety of all-you-can-drink options, including alcohol and soft drinks, and delicious meals with generous portions. They also highlight the smooth, thick, and comfortable alkaline hot spring water, and the friendly, helpful staff.

Other reviews mention staff communication can be difficult.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located south of Kimi Pass, along National Route 371, popular for tourism, leisure, and commuting.

name: 串本温泉
location: 和歌山県 西牟婁郡串本町
sales_point: 紀伊半島最南端に位置する温泉地。ダイビングや海水浴、釣りなど、マリンレジャーの基地となっている。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers stunning ocean views from all rooms, including the Hashigui-iwa rocks, and features a wide variety of buffet dishes, including fresh tuna and local specialties. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the food can be unappetizing.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southernmost tip of the Kii Peninsula, serving as a base for marine leisure activities such as diving, swimming, and fishing.

name: 高野山温泉
location: 和歌山県 伊都郡高野町
sales_point: 真言密教の聖地として知られる高野山は、「紀伊の霊場と参詣道」として世界遺産に登録されている。53ある高野山の宿坊の中で唯一温泉がある。
review_summary: People say this temple offers delicious and filling vegetarian meals, beautiful traditional Japanese-style rooms, and a unique natural hot spring with outdoor baths. They also highlight the stunning gardens, including a stone garden, and the opportunity to join morning prayers and calligraphy experiences. Guests mention the staff are friendly, welcoming, and provide clear explanations in English.
sales_point_en: Koyasan, known as a sacred site of Shingon Buddhism, is registered as a World Heritage site as 'Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range'. It is the only hot spring among the 53 lodges in Koyasan.

name: 高野槙の湯温泉
location: 和歌山県 伊都郡高野町
sales_point: 高野山の南方、有田川沿いに位置する温泉地。高野山を訪れた後に、川のせせらぎと共に疲れを癒すには最適な環境。山菜など山の幸を堪能できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Aritagawa River, south of Koyasan. It offers a perfect environment to relax after visiting Koyasan, with the soothing sound of the river. Enjoy mountain delicacies such as wild vegetables.

name: 小又川温泉
sales_point: 牛廻山の西側山麓、日高川の支流の小又川沿いに位置する温泉地。龍神温泉と共に国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Komata River, a tributary of the Hidaka River, on the western foothills of Ushimawarayama. Designated as a national health resort along with Ryujin Onsen.

name: 才野温泉
location: 和歌山県 西牟婁郡白浜町
sales_point: 白浜温泉の南東、才野地区に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、見晴らしが良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Saino district, southeast of Shirahama Onsen, in a quiet environment with good views.

name: しみず温泉
location: 和歌山県 有田郡有田川町
sales_point: 有田川を見下ろす丘の中腹に位置する温泉地。ログハウス、バンガローが完備してあり、家族連れなどでアウトドアを楽しむのに最適。
review_summary:
People say this day-trip hot spring facility is new, very clean, and features a main bath, a cold spring bath, and a mist sauna. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, and the excellent water quality.

Other reviews mention the mist sauna can be more like a shower.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a hillside overlooking the Aritagawa River, equipped with log houses and bungalows, making it ideal for families and outdoor activities.

name: 白浜温泉
location: 和歌山県 西牟婁郡白浜町
spa_quality: 炭酸水素塩泉、塩化物泉
sales_point: 紀伊半島南西部の海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。日本書紀などに牟婁の湯と記載され歴史が永い。紺碧の海と円月島、千畳敷など風光明媚な温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the southwestern coast of the Kii Peninsula, with a long history mentioned in historical texts like the Nihon Shoki. A scenic area with deep blue seas, Engetsu Island, and Chichibujima.

name: すさみ温泉
location: 和歌山県 西牟婁郡すさみ町
sales_point: 周参見湾に面した温泉地。目前に稲積島を望み、景観がよい。磯釣りや船釣りが楽しめる。枯木灘の眺望が良く、夕陽は絶景。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features clean facilities and ocean-view open-air baths, including unique pot-shaped tubs, with many highlighting the smooth, skin-softening water quality. They also appreciate the convenient operating hours, including early mornings, and the availability of cashless payment options. Guests mention the staff are generally helpful and attentive, contributing to a relaxing experience.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing the Kumano Sea, with a view of Inazumi Island right in front, offering great scenery. Enjoy rock fishing and boat fishing, with beautiful views of the Karekawa Bay and stunning sunsets.

name: 千里浜温泉
location: 和歌山県 日高郡みなべ町
sales_point: みなべ温泉の3キロ北西側の太平洋に面した温泉地。太平洋を望む絶好のロケーション。パノラマに広がる水平線にしずむ夕陽はとてもきれい。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers a wide variety of delicious buffet dishes, including local Wakayama specialties and international cuisine, with unlimited alcoholic beverages. Guests also highlight the stunning ocean views from the rooms and the spacious, clean hot spring baths.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located 3 kilometers northwest of Minabe Onsen, facing the Pacific Ocean. It offers a perfect location with beautiful sunsets over the panoramic horizon.

name: 太地温泉
location: 和歌山県 東牟婁郡太地町
sales_point: 紀伊半島南東部の太地町に位置する温泉地。日本の捕鯨発祥の地でくじらの博物館などもある。風光明媚な環境にあり、観光の拠点にもよい。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious French course dinners and satisfying breakfasts, often accompanied by live piano music. They also highlight the attentive staff and the relaxing outdoor baths with scenic views.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Taiji Town in the southeastern part of the Kii Peninsula. Known as the birthplace of whaling in Japan, it features a whale museum and is surrounded by beautiful scenery, making it a great base for tourism.

name: 高田温泉
sales_point: 熊野川河口の西側の山あいに位置する温泉地。熊野灘観光の拠点に好適。また、登山、ハイキングなども楽しめる。湯は乳白色しており薬草風呂も完備している。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a relaxing outdoor bath with quality alkaline spring water, and provides comfortable Japanese-style rooms with AC. Guests also highlight the delicious, filling meals, efficient shuttle service, and reasonable prices.

Some reviews mention the room soundproofing can be poor.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains on the west side of the Kumano River estuary. It is an ideal base for sightseeing in Kumano-nada and offers opportunities for mountain climbing and hiking. The water is milky white and includes herbal baths.

name: 高津尾温泉
location: 和歌山県 日高郡日高川町
sales_point: 紀州の国の山あいに位置する温泉地。「安珍清姫」で有名な日高川を眼下に見下ろす、閑静な環境にある。美肌効果が高く、肌がすべすべする。ゆったり、のんびりくつろげる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains of Kishu, overlooking the tranquil Hidaka River, famous for the legend of Anchin and Kiyohime. The water is known for its skin beautifying effects, providing a smooth feel, perfect for relaxation.

name: 田辺温泉
sales_point: 雄大な太平洋を望む海岸沿いに位置した温泉地。夕日を見ながら、心身共にくつろぐことができる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious open-air baths with varying temperatures, allowing visitors to choose their preferred warmth, and appreciate the high-quality, free-flowing spring water. They also highlight the early morning opening hours, the availability of amenities like shampoo and body soap, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the large open-air bath can be under renovation.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast with a magnificent view of the Pacific Ocean. Guests can relax both body and mind while watching the sunset.

name: 玉川やどり温泉
sales_point: かつらぎ高野山系県立自然公園内に位置する温泉地。緑と水に囲まれた渓谷沿いにあり、自然環境に恵まれている。ハイキング、登山客に好評。
review_summary: People say this onsen has excellent quality hot springs with a smooth, soft texture, and many highlight the seasonal outdoor spring-fed pool. They also mention the delicious food, especially the fried chicken and wild boar dishes, and appreciate the friendly and attentive staff.
sales_point_en: Situated within the Katsuragi-Koyasan Prefectural Natural Park, this hot spring area is located along a valley surrounded by greenery and water, making it a haven for nature lovers. It is popular among hikers and climbers.

name: 近露温泉
sales_point: 日置川河畔に位置する温泉地。山々に囲まれた緑豊かで静かな環境にある。登山、ハイキング客などにも好評。
review_summary: People say this inn offers delicious and authentic Japanese meals, including vegetarian options, and features comfortable rooms with traditional futons. Guests also highlight the relaxing onsen overlooking the river and the convenient location for Kumano Kodo hikers. They also mention the welcoming and helpful staff, who provide excellent service.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the Hiki River, surrounded by lush mountains in a quiet environment. It is well-received by mountain climbers and hikers.

name: 月野瀬温泉
location: 和歌山県 東牟婁郡古座川町
sales_point: 古座峡の渓谷近くに位置する温泉地。
review_summary: People say this accommodation offers clean rooms and a natural hot spring bath with a smooth, alkaline water quality. Guests also highlight the delicious, freshly baked bread available at the on-site shop and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere. They also appreciate the convenient, free parking and the option for self-check-in.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the gorge of Koza.

name: 椿温泉
location: 和歌山県 西牟婁郡白浜町
sales_point: 白浜温泉の南側にある小さな入り江に面した温泉地。温暖な気候で古くから湯治客も多い。湯触りはなめらかで美肌の湯と言われる。
sales_point_en: A small hot spring area facing a cove south of Shirahama Onsen. Known for its warm climate, it has been popular with hot spring visitors for a long time. The water is smooth and is said to be good for beautiful skin.

name: 夏山温泉
location: 和歌山県 東牟婁郡太地町
sales_point: 湯川湾沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。熊野灘の眺望が良く、釣りも楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yukawa Bay, in a quiet environment suitable for recuperation and relaxation. It offers great views of Kumano-nada and opportunities for fishing.

name: 南紀の台温泉
sales_point: 田辺市街と白浜温泉の中間に位置し、田辺湾の眺望が素晴らしい温泉地。白浜観光の足場にも良い。
review_summary: People say this hot spring offers a unique, private bathing experience in a small, rustic rock bath, with the water color changing throughout the day. Visitors also highlight the affordable 800 yen fee, which includes access to a nearby public bath with showers and amenities. They also like the option to boil eggs in the hot spring water and the overall historic, sacred atmosphere.
sales_point_en: Located between Tanabe City and Shirahama Onsen, this hot spring area offers stunning views of Tanabe Bay. It serves as a good base for sightseeing in Shirahama.

name: 早藤温泉
location: 和歌山県 日高郡日高川町
sales_point: 日高川付近に位置する温泉地。四百年の栽培歴史をもつ川辺みかんが特産物。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the Hidaka River, known for its specialty of riverbank mikan oranges, which have a cultivation history of over 400 years.

name: 花園温泉
location: 和歌山県 伊都郡花園村
sales_point: 奈良県に隣接する花園村の西端、有田川沿いに位置する温泉地。せせらぎと緑あふれる環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。夏は川魚料理、冬はボタン鍋が味わえる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious and voluminous meals, including fresh ayu no shioyaki and seasonal kaiseki, and features clean, comfortable rooms with convenient charging stations. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, as well as the relaxing onsen.

Some reviews mention the Wi-Fi can be unreliable.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Arida River at the western edge of Hanazono Village, adjacent to Nara Prefecture. It is surrounded by lush greenery and flowing streams, making it ideal for recuperation and relaxation. In summer, guests can enjoy river fish dishes, and in winter, the famous button hot pot.

name: 花山温泉
location: 和歌山県 和歌山市
sales_point: 和歌山市北東部にある花山の山麓に位置する温泉地。行基の発見と伝えられ、歴史が永い。
review_summary: People say this onsen has incredibly rich, reddish-brown carbonated spring water with abundant iron content and unique mineral deposits, offering various temperatures for a satisfying alternating bath experience. They also highlight the delicious, seasonal meals and the attentive, friendly staff. Visitors appreciate the convenient access and the option to take home some of the beneficial spring water.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Hanayama in the northeastern part of Wakayama City. It is said to have been discovered by Gyoki and has a long history.

name: 日置川温泉
location: 和歌山県 西牟婁郡白浜町
sales_point: 雄大な志原海岸に面した温泉地。周辺は磯遊びや釣りを楽しむのに最適。家族連れなどで賑わいを見せる。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a high-quality, strong alkaline spring with a unique "torotoro" (thick and smooth) texture that leaves skin feeling soft and moisturized. They also highlight the ocean-view open-air bath, the spacious sauna, and the variety of amenities, including collagen facial cleansers. Guests mention the option to purchase the popular onsen lotion and appreciate the clean and well-maintained facilities.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing the majestic Shihara Coast. The surrounding area is perfect for tide pooling and fishing, making it popular with families.

name: 二川温泉
location: 和歌山県 有田郡有田川町
sales_point: 清水町の西部、有田川沿いに位置する温泉地。建物は原木丸太を使用したユニークな円形ドーム型になっている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Arida River in the western part of Shimizu Town. The building features a unique circular dome shape made from raw logs.

name: 美里温泉
location: 和歌山県 海草郡紀美野町
sales_point: 貴志川沿いに位置する温泉地。約1300年前に発見されたと伝えられる、歴史のある山あいの湯。また、鮎釣りなども楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Kishi River, believed to have been discovered about 1300 years ago. It is a historic mountain hot spring, and guests can also enjoy ayu fishing.

name: 美嶋温泉
location: 和歌山県 伊都郡かつらぎ町
sales_point: ＪＲ笠田駅の南方約6キロの国道480号線沿いに位置する温泉地。渓流釣りや森林浴、秋には栗狩りも楽しむことが出来る。平成11年1月にリフレッシュオープン。
sales_point_en: Located about 6 kilometers south of JR Kasada Station along National Route 480, this hot spring area offers opportunities for stream fishing, forest bathing, and chestnut picking in autumn. It was refreshed and reopened in January 1999.

name: みなべ温泉
location: 和歌山県 日高郡みなべ町
sales_point: 埴田崎に位置する温泉地。南部湾を一望し、眼下に広がる紺碧の海がとてもロマンチック。海水浴場も近く、釣りも楽しめる。美肌効果の高い湯として知られる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers ocean views from rooms and open-air baths, and features a smooth, skin-friendly hot spring. Guests also highlight the delicious meals, especially the fresh seafood and local umeboshi, and the reasonable prices.

Some reviews mention the facility can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at Haniyazaki, offering a panoramic view of the Nambu Bay and the deep blue sea below, creating a romantic atmosphere. The nearby beach is perfect for swimming, and fishing is also enjoyable. It is known for its skin beautifying effects.

name: 美山温泉
location: 和歌山県 日高郡日高川町
sales_point: 四方を山に囲まれた美山村に位置する温泉地。清流日高川の上流の閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。釣りや登山を楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the village of Miyama, surrounded by mountains. It is in a quiet environment upstream of the clear Hidaka River, making it ideal for recuperation and relaxation. Guests can enjoy fishing and mountain climbing.

name: 湯浅温泉
location: 和歌山県 有田郡湯浅町
sales_point: 有田みかんで有名な湯浅町中央部の山あいに位置する温泉地。浴場からは湯浅湾を見下ろせる。眺望が良く保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a unique castle-like exterior, with a smooth, skin-beautifying spring water, and offers delicious, colorful, and voluminous meals.

Other reviews mention the service can be unprofessional and the rooms can be damp.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains of central Yuasa Town, famous for its Arita mikan oranges. The bathhouse offers a view overlooking Yuasa Bay, providing a great view and is suitable for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 湯川温泉
location: 和歌山県 東牟婁郡那智勝浦町
sales_point: 湯川湾の静かな入り江、ゆかし潟に面して湧く温泉地。
review_summary: People say this onsen features abundant, continuously flowing spring water that is slightly cool, making it ideal for long, relaxing soaks. They also highlight the spotless and well-maintained facilities, despite the simple amenities. Guests mention the affordable 400 yen entry fee and the option to purchase amenities like soap and towels on-site.
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area facing the calm inlet of Yukawa Bay.

name: 湯の花温泉
location: 和歌山県 東牟婁郡古座川町
sales_point: 七川ダムに面した温泉地。釣り人に人気があり釣り客が多く訪れる。又、桜の名所で春先は賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing the Nanagawa Dam, popular among anglers and bustling in spring due to cherry blossoms.

name: 湯の峰（熊野本宮温泉郷）
sales_point: 発見は1800年前、熊野詣の湯垢離場として栄えてきた歴史の永い温泉地。1日に7度も色が変わるという「つぼ湯」がある。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: People say this hot spring offers a unique, private bathing experience in a small, rustic rock bath, with the water color changing throughout the day. Visitors also highlight the affordable 800 yen fee, which includes access to a nearby public bath with showers and amenities. They also like the option to boil eggs in the hot spring water and the overall historic, sacred atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A historic hot spring area that has flourished as a purification site for Kumano pilgrimages for 1800 years, featuring a 'tsubo-yu' that changes color seven times a day. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 龍神温泉
sales_point: 日高川の渓流沿いに位置する山峡の温泉地。1300年の歴史を誇り、徳川頼宣公の別荘もあったと伝えられる。日本三美人の湯のひとつに数えられる。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers a unique "beauty-enhancing" hot spring experience with its distinctive silky, smooth water that leaves skin feeling soft and moisturized. They also highlight the peaceful atmosphere, with many enjoying the natural surroundings and river views from the outdoor baths. Guests mention the facilities are clean and well-maintained, and the staff are friendly and helpful.
sales_point_en: A mountain hot spring area located along the Hidaka River, boasting a history of 1300 years and said to have been a villa for Tokugawa Yoshitsugu. Considered one of Japan's three beautiful hot springs. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 和歌浦温泉
location: 和歌山県 和歌山市
sales_point: 和歌山市内の歴史ある観光地「和歌の浦」のホテル内にある温泉。宿泊者、又は食事客のみ利用可。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious and fresh Japanese-style multi-course dinners and breakfasts, with many highlighting the flavorful seafood and Kumano beef. They also appreciate the stunning ocean views from the rooms and open-air baths, along with the attentive and friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the drinks can be expensive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located within a hotel in the historic tourist area of Wakaura in Wakayama City, accessible only to guests and diners.

name: 渡瀬（熊野本宮温泉郷）
sales_point: 四村川沿いに位置した山間の温泉地。付近はキャンプ場などが整備され、自然環境が良い。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious open-air baths with varying temperatures, allowing visitors to choose their preferred warmth, and appreciate the high-quality, free-flowing spring water. They also highlight the early morning opening hours, the availability of amenities like shampoo and body soap, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the large open-air bath can be under renovation.
sales_point_en: A mountain hot spring area located along the Shimura River, surrounded by well-maintained camping sites and a good natural environment. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 天見温泉
location: 大阪府 河内長野市
sales_point: 天見川沿いに位置する温泉地。四方を緑の山並みに囲まれた閑静な環境にある。
review_summary: People say this ryokan offers delicious and authentic multi-course kaiseki meals, including vegan options, and features a relaxing onsen with garden views. They also highlight the beautiful, well-maintained traditional building and gardens, providing a peaceful and authentic Japanese experience. Guests mention the staff are kind, attentive, and provide excellent service, with many speaking English.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Amami River, set in a quiet environment surrounded by green mountains.

name: 生駒山龍間温泉
sales_point: 生駒国定公園内の阪奈ゴルフ場に隣接している温泉地。プレーしなくても宿泊可。大阪平野を一望できる環境にあり、眺望が良い。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a wide and spacious open-air bath with a smooth, skin-softening water quality. They also highlight the delicious and fresh seafood dishes, including sushi and sashimi, which are generously portioned and offer good value.

Other reviews mention the amenities can be lacking.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area adjacent to the Hanna Golf Course in Ikoma National Park, offering great views of the Osaka Plain, even for non-golfers.

name: 石切温泉
sales_point: 生駒山の西側裾野に位置する温泉地。大阪平野を一望でき、眺望が良い。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers delicious food, including a popular Chinese buffet, and features a fantastic sky terrace with stunning views of the Osaka plain and city nightscape.

Other reviews mention the baths can be poorly maintained and the service can be slow.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foothills of Ikoma Mountain, providing excellent views of the Osaka Plain.

name: 犬鳴山温泉
sales_point: 和歌山県との県境に近い犬鳴山の山麓に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれており、犬鳴山ハイキングの足場に好適。大阪近郊の避暑地としても賑わいを見せる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has excellent quality hot spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth and soft, with many highlighting its unique, thick texture. They also mention the staff are helpful and the facility offers a secluded, rustic atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Inunaki Mountain, near the border with Wakayama Prefecture, blessed with a rich natural environment and a popular spot for hiking.

name: 牛滝温泉
sales_point: 岸和田市南部の牛滝山に位置する温泉地。平成11年5月にオープンした新しい温泉。テントサイトやコテージも併設され、アウトドアライフも楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A new hot spring opened in May 1999, located on Ushitaki Mountain in southern Kishiwada City, with tent sites and cottages for outdoor activities.

name: 大阪サンパレス温泉
sales_point: 万博記念公園すぐ横に位置する温泉地。交通の便がとても良い。大阪、兵庫観光拠点に好適。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers stunning lake views from the lobby, rooms, and onsen, with a wide variety of buffet dishes. They also highlight the excellent hot springs, spacious pools, and the nightly fireworks over the lake.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located right next to the Expo Memorial Park, with excellent transportation access, ideal for sightseeing in Osaka and Hyogo.

name: 奥水間温泉
sales_point: 泉州葛城山の南西側山麓に位置する温泉地。高城山、葛城山などの登山基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southwestern foothills of Mount Katsuragi in Senshu, suitable as a base for climbing nearby mountains.

name: 樫田温泉
sales_point: 高槻森林観光センターの内に位置する温泉地。周辺にはキャンプ場などのレジャー施設が整備されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within the Takatsuki Forest Tourism Center, surrounded by leisure facilities like camping sites.

name: かつらぎ温泉
location: 大阪府 南河内郡河南町
sales_point: 奈良県と隣接している河南町南部、ワールド牧場内に位置する温泉地。北隣にゴルフ場もある。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen offers a variety of high-quality hot springs, including unique fossil seawater and carbonated baths, along with well-maintained rock saunas and foot baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices, the availability of rental towels and loungewear, and the attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the service can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the southern part of Kanan Town, adjacent to Nara Prefecture, within World Farm, with a golf course nearby.

name: 堺市温泉
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including natural hot springs, carbonated baths, and open-air options, with many enjoying the hot saunas and steam rooms. They also highlight the delicious food at the restaurant, the free massage chairs in the bedrock bath area, and the ample parking.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be crowded.

name: 汐の湯温泉
location: 大阪府 豊能郡能勢町
sales_point: 国道173号線沿いに位置する温泉地。眼前を山田川が流れ、釣りや川遊びが楽しめる。近郊の人々の保養場として賑わう。神経痛、筋肉痛、きりきず、やけど、慢性皮膚炎に効能がある。秋には、椎茸、松茸狩りもできる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 173, with the Yamada River flowing nearby, offering fishing and river play. A popular health resort for locals, effective for neuralgia, muscle pain, cuts, burns, and chronic dermatitis. Mushroom picking is also available in autumn.

name: 太子温泉
location: 大阪府 南河内郡太子町
sales_point: 聖徳太子廟をはじめとする飛鳥時代の天皇陵や多くの古墳群が点在する太子町に位置する温泉地。太子町は日本最古の宮道と言われる竹内街道が通り、「近つ飛鳥」と呼ばれている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features natural, free-flowing hot spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth, and offers a relaxing open-air bath. They also highlight the delicious egg dishes and kamameshi at the restaurant, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the water can be overpriced.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Taishi Town, which is dotted with ancient tombs and the mausoleum of Prince Shotoku, known for its historical significance.

name: 千亀利の湯温泉
sales_point: 岸和田港の近くに位置する温泉地。健康温泉ランドも併設されている。だんじり祭など岸和田観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Kishiwada Port, featuring a health hot spring land, ideal as a base for Kishiwada tourism, including the Danjiri Festival.

name: 天王寺世界の（温泉）
sales_point: 天王寺動物園に隣接する市街地に位置する温泉地。世界11ヶ国16種類のお風呂と南国情緒あふれるプールが楽しめる都市型リゾート温泉パーク。
review_summary:
People say this resort offers a wide variety of themed hot springs and saunas, along with a spacious pool area that provides fun for all ages. Guests also highlight the excellent value for money, the availability of towels and amenities, and the convenient cashless payment system.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the urban area adjacent to Tennoji Zoo, featuring baths from 11 countries and a tropical-themed pool, making it a city resort hot spring park.

name: 富田林嶽山温泉
sales_point: 楠木政成公ゆかりの古戦場、標高280メートルの嶽山山頂に位置する温泉地。四季を通じて朝夕の絶景を楽しめる。「かんぽの宿富田林」では日帰り入浴も可能。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious crab all-you-can-eat and a wide variety of other dishes, including a satisfying breakfast buffet. They also highlight the all-inclusive plan, which provides great value, and the attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the service can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the summit of Gakuzan Mountain, 280 meters above sea level, known for its historical significance related to Masanari Kusunoki. Visitors can enjoy breathtaking views throughout the seasons. Day-use bathing is available at 'Kanpo no Yado Tomitayama'.

name: 長野温泉
location: 大阪府 河内長野市
sales_point: 石川沿いに位置する温泉地。長野公園の入口にある。金剛寺、延命寺、観心寺探訪拠点に好適。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers delicious and authentic Japanese cuisine, including fresh seafood and flavorful meat dishes, with options for allergy accommodations. They also highlight the natural hot spring baths, featuring both indoor and open-air options, and the clean, comfortable rooms. Guests mention the friendly and attentive staff, the reasonable prices, and the convenient shuttle bus service from the nearby station.
sales_point_en: A hot spring situated along the Ishikawa River, located at the entrance of Nagano Park. It serves as a great base for exploring Kongō-ji, Enmei-ji, and Kanshinji temples.

name: 能勢簡易保険保養センター
location: 大阪府 豊能郡能勢町
sales_point: 山辺川沿いに位置する温泉地。お湯は神経痛、筋肉痛、関節痛に効能がある。キャンプ場も併設されており、隣接には「能勢の郷」があり、一日中楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along the Yamabe River, known for its therapeutic effects on neuralgia, muscle pain, and joint pain. It also features a campsite and is adjacent to 'Nose no Sato', providing a full day of enjoyment.

name: 花の里温泉
sales_point: 摂津峡の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。山々の緑に囲まれ自然環境に恵まれている。桜の頃は特に美しい。露天風呂が自慢。
review_summary:
People say this inn offers delicious meals, especially the kiji nabe, and features clean, well-maintained facilities. Guests also highlight the relaxing hot springs with scenic views and the convenient shuttle bus service from Takatsuki Station.

Some reviews mention the outdoor bath can be exposed.
sales_point_en: Nestled along the scenic Settsukyo Gorge, this hot spring is surrounded by lush green mountains and offers a beautiful natural environment, especially stunning during cherry blossom season. It boasts an outdoor bath.

name: 伏尾温泉
sales_point: 余野川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。山間の閑静な環境にある。新緑と紅葉の時期は絶景。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers spacious rooms, some with private open-air baths and scenic views, and a wide variety of delicious dishes for dinner and breakfast. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, and the convenient shuttle bus service from Hankyu Ikeda Station.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: Located along the clear stream of the Yono River, this hot spring is set in a tranquil mountain environment. The views during the fresh green and autumn foliage seasons are breathtaking.

name: 箕面温泉
sales_point: 箕面山の渓谷入口に位置する温泉地。一帯が「明治の森箕面国定公園」に指定され、自然環境がよい。展望露天風呂からは阪神の見事な夜景が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Situated at the entrance of the Minoh Mountain gorge, this hot spring is part of the 'Meiji no Mori Minoh National Park', offering excellent natural surroundings. The open-air bath provides stunning night views of the Hanshin area.

name: 八尾天然温泉
sales_point: 八尾空港の北東約1.5キロ、八尾市街地に位置する温泉地。楠木正成が秘湯・隠し湯として大切にした。久宝寺など名勝地を散歩しながらゆっくり訪れることができる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers excellent natural hot springs with various baths, including a deep cold bath and a hot bath perfect for alternating temperatures. They also highlight the enjoyable popular theater performances and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the service can be unprofessional.
sales_point_en: Located about 1.5 kilometers northeast of Yao Airport, this hot spring is in the city center. It was cherished as a secret hot spring by Masanari Kusunoki. Visitors can leisurely explore nearby attractions like Kubo-ji.

name: 湯元摂津峡温泉
sales_point: 花の里温泉から芥川下流約800メートルのところに位置する温泉地。四季折々の美しい自然に囲まれた静かな保養場。近郊の人々にも親しまれている。
review_summary:
People say this inn offers delicious meals, especially the kiji nabe, and features clean, well-maintained facilities. Guests also highlight the relaxing hot springs with scenic views and the convenient shuttle bus service from Takatsuki Station.

Some reviews mention the outdoor bath can be exposed.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located about 800 meters downstream from Hana no Sato Onsen, surrounded by beautiful nature throughout the seasons. It is a quiet retreat popular among local residents.

name: 由松乃湯温泉
sales_point: 関西地方の玄関口、関西国際空港まで約9キロの泉佐野市市街地に位置する温泉地。海外旅行前後の休息地に好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers private and public onsens, with some featuring saunas, and delicious meals for both dinner and breakfast. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, the clean and comfortable rooms, and the convenient airport shuttle service.

Some reviews mention the hot spring water can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: Located in the city center of Izumisano, about 9 kilometers from Kansai International Airport, this hot spring is ideal for relaxation before or after international travel.

name: 井谷屋温泉
sales_point: 初瀬ダムの南方、長谷寺の門前に位置する温泉地。花の寺としても有名で、桜・ぼたんの名所としても知られている。
review_summary:
People say this traditional inn offers delicious, fresh Japanese cuisine and a spacious, relaxing hot spring bath. They also highlight the attentive staff, who provide excellent service and convenient shuttle transportation.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be dated.
sales_point_en: Situated south of the Hase Dam, in front of Hase-dera Temple, this hot spring is famous for its flower temple and is known for its cherry blossoms and peonies.

name: 大塔温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡大塔村
sales_point: 猿谷ダムの南、国道168号線沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。緑があふれ、澄んだ空気の中で、夜には満天の星空が輝く。心身共にリラックスできる。
review_summary:
Reviewers praise this roadside station for its delicious tempura rice bowls and hot dogs, unique UFO-shaped building, and spacious restrooms.

Other reviews mention the toilets can be poorly maintained and have a strong odor.
sales_point_en: Located in the mountains along National Route 168, south of the Sarutani Dam, this hot spring is surrounded by lush greenery and clear air, with a starry sky at night, perfect for relaxation.

name: 奥香落温泉
location: 奈良県 宇陀郡曽爾村
sales_point: 室生・赤目・青山国定公園ないに位置する温泉地。自然に恵まれた静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。縄文遺跡や神話伝承か多く残され、奥香落渓や曽爾高原などの探索拠点にも良い。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located within the Murou-Akame-Aoyama National Park, in a serene environment blessed by nature, ideal for recuperation. It serves as a great base for exploring Jomon ruins and mythological sites.

name: 上北山温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡上北山村
sales_point: 大台ヶ原山の山麓に位置する温泉地。豊富な湯量と泉質は県内でもトップクラスに入る。熊野灘までは車で約50分なので山あいにありながら、魚介類も味わえる。鹿や鴨、山菜なども味わ宇ことが出来る。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has good quality, alkaline hot spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth, and the facilities are clean and well-maintained. Guests also highlight the attentive and kind staff, and the quiet atmosphere with mountain views.

Some reviews mention the parking can be confusing.
sales_point_en: Located at the foot of Mount Odaigahara, this hot spring boasts one of the highest volumes and quality of water in the prefecture. It is about a 50-minute drive to Kumano-nada, allowing visitors to enjoy seafood as well as deer, duck, and wild vegetables.

name: 上湯（十津川温泉郷）
location: 奈良県 吉野郡十津川村
sales_point: 奈良県最奥の名湯。享保年間に里人が川原に湧く湯を発見したと伝えられ、歴史が永い。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers a spacious, open-air bath with excellent views of the river and surrounding nature, and many highlight the unique experience of cooling off in the adjacent river. They also mention the water has a pleasant sulfur scent, a smooth texture, and is effective for warming the body. Guests appreciate the reasonable 500 yen fee and the availability of basic amenities like shampoo and body soap.
sales_point_en: The most remote famous hot spring in Nara Prefecture, believed to have been discovered by locals during the Kyōhō era. It has a long history and is recognized as a national health resort.

name: 雲之上温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡野迫川村
sales_point: 荒神岳の北東側山麓に位置する温泉地。弘法大師が高野山開山の際に創建されたとされる。荒神社参拝に最適。
sales_point_en: Located on the northeastern foothills of Kojindake, this hot spring is said to have been established by Kobo Daishi during the founding of Mount Koya. It is ideal for visiting the nearby Kojin Shrine.

name: 小処温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡上北山村
sales_point: 大台ヶ原山西側山麓、小橡川上流北山峡沿いに位置する温泉地。登山客の利用が多い。野猿の姿も見える山深い地で渓谷美を満喫できる。1月中旬～3月中旬は休業。
sales_point_en: Situated on the western foothills of Mount Odaigahara, along the upper reaches of the Koshigawa River, this hot spring is popular among hikers. It offers beautiful valley scenery and is home to wild monkeys. Closed from mid-January to mid-March.

name: 入之波温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡川上村
spa_quality: 単純温泉、炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 近畿地方最大の秘境、大台ヶ原の北側、大迫ダム湖畔に位置する温泉地。吉野杉やトチの木を使った浴場は野趣満点。登山やアウトドアスポーツ基地としても好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring features a unique, golden-colored, free-flowing spring with a high mineral content that creates impressive, layered deposits on the bath walls and a relaxing, mild temperature. They also highlight the delicious kamameshi and duck dishes available at the restaurant, recommending ordering food before bathing. Guests mention the staff are kind and the facilities are clean and well-maintained, despite the older building.
sales_point_en: Located in the largest hidden area in the Kinki region, on the northern side of Mount Odaigahara, by the lake of the Oosako Dam. The bathhouse made of Yoshino cedar and horse chestnut wood offers a rustic experience, making it suitable for hiking and outdoor sports.

name: 信貴山温泉
location: 奈良県 生駒郡三郷町
sales_point: 金剛・生駒国定公園の中程に位置する温泉地。毘沙門天の聖地。信貴山寺が近く、静かな環境にある。湯は美肌効果があると言われる。信貴山・奈良観光の拠点に好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this traditional inn offers delicious multi-course Japanese meals and a natural hot spring bath with scenic outdoor views, especially during cherry blossom season. They also highlight the reasonable prices, attentive staff, and convenient location near Shigosonji Temple.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: Located in the middle of the Kongō-Ikoma National Park, this hot spring is a sacred site of Bishamonten. Close to Shigisan-ji Temple, it is in a quiet environment and is said to have skin-beautifying effects, making it a great base for sightseeing in Shigisan and Nara.

name: 下市温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡下市町
sales_point: 国道309号と県道48号の合流地点に位置する温泉地。古くは桃花（つき）の里と呼ばれていた静かな環境の秋津川のほとりにある。近くには梅林が広がる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including indoor and open-air options, along with a sauna, and provides shampoo and body soap. They also highlight the reasonable 500-yen entry fee, the friendly staff, and the on-site dining with hearty meals.

Other reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Located at the confluence of National Route 309 and Prefectural Route 48, this hot spring is in a quiet environment along the Akitsukawa River, historically known as the village of Momohana. Nearby, there is a plum grove.

name: 下北山温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡下北山村
sales_point: 涅槃岳東側山麓に位置する温泉地。山々に囲まれた閑静な環境で保養・休養に好適。池原ダム探勝や登山基地にも良い。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including indoor and open-air options, a sauna, and a "nuruyu" (lukewarm water) bath. They also highlight the smooth, skin-softening water quality and the spacious, clean changing rooms. Guests mention the attentive staff and the delicious food available at the on-site restaurant.
sales_point_en: Situated on the eastern foothills of Nirvana Peak, this hot spring is in a tranquil environment surrounded by mountains, ideal for recuperation. It also serves as a good base for exploring the Ikahara Dam.

name: 新吉野温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡吉野町
sales_point: 吉野山の下千本に位置する温泉地。昔より厳しい修験道の聖地として名高い地にあり、閑静な環境にある。
review_summary:
People say this bathhouse offers an open-air bath with stunning seasonal views and comfortable, lukewarm water perfect for relaxation. Guests also appreciate the clean, new facilities and the convenience of using PayPay.

Some reviews mention parking can be difficult.
