sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the base of Yoshinoyama, renowned as a sacred site for ascetic practices since ancient times, set in a tranquil environment.

name: 天然大和温泉
sales_point: 天理市街地の嘉幡町に位置する温泉地。中国で古くから伝わる薬草湯に鎮静作用があるとされているハーブを加えた湯が好評。いろいろなお風呂も完備されている。
review_summary:
People say this facility offers a wide variety of baths, including natural hot springs, and features a spacious, clean sauna with a large TV. They also highlight the ample, free towels and amenities, as well as the extensive relaxation areas with manga and comfortable seating.

Other reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in Kahata Town in the city center of Tenri. The bath is popular for its calming herbal infusion derived from traditional Chinese medicinal herbs.

name: 天平の湯温泉
sales_point: 奈良市の中心部、市街地に位置する温泉地。平城宮跡、朱雀門、隣接する。東大寺、興福寺、春日大社へ車で約20分と観光拠点に好適。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this hotel spa for its wide variety of facilities, including a sauna with hourly löyly events and a walking pool. They also highlight the clean and well-maintained changing rooms, the quiet atmosphere, and the availability of free cold water and cooler boxes for drinks.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be dated.
sales_point_en: Located in the city center of Nara, adjacent to the Heijo Palace ruins and Suzaku Gate. It is a convenient base for sightseeing, with Todai-ji, Kofuku-ji, and Kasuga-taisha about a 20-minute drive away.

name: 湯泉地（十津川温泉郷）
location: 奈良県 吉野郡十津川村
sales_point: 紀伊山脈の深い山並みを縫うように流れる十津川の左岸に湧く温泉地。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water with a pleasant sulfur scent, featuring both an indoor bath and an open-air rotenburo. They also highlight the reasonable 600 yen entry fee and the friendly, helpful staff. Visitors appreciate the convenient parking and the availability of shampoo, body soap, and free dryers.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area that springs forth on the left bank of the Totsukawa River, flowing through the deep mountains of the Kii Mountain Range. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 十津川（十津川温泉郷）
location: 奈良県 吉野郡十津川村
sales_point: 奈良県最南端に位置し、急峻な山々に抱かれた温泉地。ダム湖に面し、風光明媚。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: Located at the southernmost tip of Nara Prefecture, surrounded by steep mountains. It faces a dam lake and offers scenic views. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 洞川温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡天川村
sales_point: 標高800メートルの山上川畔に位置する温泉地。大峰山の修験者に利用されてきた歴史を持つ。高野槙使用の大浴場を持つ村営施設もある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located by the Yamanokawa River at an elevation of 800 meters. It has a history of being used by ascetics of the Omine Mountains, and there is a village-run facility with a large bath made of Koyamaki wood.

name: 西吉野温泉
sales_point: 西吉野村の中心、城戸に位置する温泉地。四方を吉野杉や緑に囲まれており、自然環境が良い。夏は丹生川で釣りやアウトドアキャンプなどが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the center of Nishi Yoshino Village, surrounded by Yoshino cedar and greenery, providing a good natural environment. In summer, fishing and outdoor camping can be enjoyed in the Nyu River.

name: 野迫川温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡野迫川村
sales_point: 護摩壇山や伯母子岳の北側の谷あいに位置する温泉地。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious local cuisine, including "kashiki" hot pot with duck, boar, and pheasant, and fresh amago trout dishes. They also highlight the welcoming staff, the clean and well-maintained rooms, and the beautiful river and waterfall views.

Some reviews mention the access roads can be narrow and challenging.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the valley north of Gomadanzan and Obako Mountain.

name: 宝来温泉
sales_point: 平城宮跡朱雀門の西方、阪名道路沿いの丘陵地に位置する温泉地。露天風呂のある天然湧出の温泉。奈良観光に便利。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious and voluminous meals, including unique local Nara dishes and seasonal buffet items. They also highlight the kind and attentive staff, and the clean, well-maintained hot springs.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on a hillside along the Sakanan Road, west of the Heijo Palace ruins and Suzaku Gate. It features natural hot springs with outdoor baths, convenient for Nara sightseeing.

name: 本郷温泉
sales_point: 周りを小高い山に囲まれた大宇陀町に位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the quiet environment of Ōuda Town, surrounded by small hills, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 美榛温泉
sales_point: 室生湖南方の山あいに位置する温泉地。湯は効能が高く、榛原総合リハビリセンターでも利用されている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel's hot spring water is exceptionally good, leaving skin smooth and moisturized, and they appreciate the wide variety of amenities and services, including a spacious kids' room. They also highlight the delicious and satisfying meals, especially the breakfast buffet, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be smelly.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the mountains south of Muro Lake. The water is known for its high efficacy and is also used at the Hainbara Rehabilitation Center.

name: 宮滝温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡吉野町
sales_point: その昔、万葉人もたたえた景勝地に位置する温泉地。静かな環境にあり奥吉野の歴史に想いを巡らせることが出来る。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in a scenic area praised by the people of the Manyō period. It offers a quiet environment to reflect on the history of Oku Yoshino.

name: 湯盛温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡川上村
sales_point: 日本三大人工美林の吉野杉の主産地として知られ、閑静な環境にある。吉野川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious and carefully prepared meals, with many highlighting the exquisite Japanese cuisine and breakfast. They also appreciate the relaxing open-air baths with scenic views, the quiet atmosphere, and the attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the dinner portions can be small.
sales_point_en: Known as the main production area of Yoshino cedar, one of Japan's three major artificial forests, this hot spring is situated in a tranquil environment along the clear stream of the Yoshino River.

name: 吉野温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡吉野町
sales_point: 吉野山の中腹に位置する温泉地。吉水神社から十三曲がりの急坂を下った所にある。閑静な環境で、保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this bathhouse offers an open-air bath with stunning seasonal views and comfortable, lukewarm water perfect for relaxation. Guests also appreciate the clean, new facilities and the convenience of using PayPay.

Some reviews mention parking can be difficult.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on the slopes of Yoshinoyama, just down the steep slope from Yoshimizu Shrine. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 吉野山温泉
location: 奈良県 吉野郡吉野町
sales_point: 吉野山、中千本公園内に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適
review_summary:
People say this bathhouse offers an open-air bath with stunning seasonal views and comfortable, lukewarm water perfect for relaxation. Guests also appreciate the clean, new facilities and the convenience of using PayPay.

Some reviews mention parking can be difficult.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located within the middle Senbon Park on Yoshinoyama. It offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 安曇川宝船温泉
sales_point: 琵琶湖の西岸に位置する温泉地。近江長浜水泳場があり、夏季は賑わう。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has excellent quality hot spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth and warms the body to the core. Guests also highlight the delicious and thick shabu-shabu, the friendly staff, and the relaxing private open-air baths.

Other reviews mention there can be a lack of proper amenities.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on the west bank of Lake Biwa, bustling during the summer with the nearby Omi Nagahama swimming area.

name: 石山温泉
sales_point: 琵琶湖の南岸、西国札所の石山寺の門前に位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in front of Ishiyama-dera Temple, a sacred site of the Western pilgrimage, on the southern shore of Lake Biwa.

name: 今浜温泉
sales_point: 琵琶湖大橋のたもと、湖の東岸に位置する温泉地。プール、テニスなどスポーツ施設も充実している。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including a spacious and concentrated carbonated spring, and a self-löyly sauna. They also highlight the delicious and voluminous food, ample parking, and comfortable relaxation areas with manga.

Other reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the foot of the Biwako Ohashi Bridge, on the eastern shore of Lake Biwa. It is well-equipped with sports facilities such as pools and tennis courts.

name: エクシブ琵琶湖温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ米原駅の西方、約２キロに位置する温泉地。琵琶湖が眼前にあり、景観がよい。琵琶湖探勝の基地に好適。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers spacious, clean rooms with stunning Lake Biwa views, and delicious dining options, including Omi beef and French toast. They also highlight the excellent service from the attentive staff and the relaxing natural hot spring baths.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located about 2 kilometers west of JR Maibara Station, with a great view of Lake Biwa, making it a suitable base for exploring the lake.

name: 近江温泉
sales_point: 琵琶湖の東側、湖東山三の中心に位置する温泉地。近江の歴史や郷土文化にふれる湖東めぐりの拠点としても好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including open-air baths with river views, and a salt sauna, with many appreciating the "beautiful skin" quality of the water. They also highlight the value of the admission fee, which includes rock bathing, towels, and loungewear, and the delicious local cuisine.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on the eastern side of Lake Biwa, in the center of the Kotozan area, making it a great base for exploring the history and local culture of Omi.

name: 雄琴温泉
sales_point: 比叡山の東側に位置する温泉地。約1200年前、最澄によって開湯されたと伝えられる。琵琶湖畔の風光明媚な立地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the eastern side of Mount Hiei. It is said to have been opened by Saicho about 1200 years ago, set in a picturesque location by Lake Biwa.

name: かもしか温泉
sales_point: 鈴鹿連山を遠望する自然の中に位置する温泉地。美肌効果の高い湯で「美人の湯」としても知られている。また、痛風に効果があると言われ、近郊の人々の療養にも親しまれて入る。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious food, including Omi beef steak and banquet meals, and features clean, spacious rooms with a Japanese-modern design. They also highlight the pleasant hot springs, attentive staff, and a shop with unique outdoor and pet items.

Some reviews mention access can be inconvenient without a car.
sales_point_en: Nestled in nature with a distant view of the Suzuka Mountains, this hot spring is known for its skin-beautifying effects and is referred to as 'Beauty Hot Spring.' It is also said to be effective for gout and is popular among locals for therapeutic purposes.

name: 黒川温泉
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious indoor and outdoor baths with high-quality, skin-smoothing alkaline water. They also highlight the clean facilities, ample amenities, and the quiet, uncrowded atmosphere, especially on weekdays.

Other reviews mention the pricing can be expensive.

name: 甲南温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ甲南駅に程近く、甲南町が一望できる小高い丘に位置する温泉地。眺望が良く閑静な環境で、保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious indoor and outdoor baths with high-quality, skin-smoothing alkaline water. They also highlight the clean facilities, ample amenities, and the quiet, uncrowded atmosphere, especially on weekdays.

Other reviews mention the pricing can be expensive.
sales_point_en: Located on a small hill near JR Konan Station, this hot spring offers a panoramic view of Konan Town. It is in a quiet environment, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 塩野温泉
sales_point: 甲賀流忍術発祥の地として知られる甲南町に位置する温泉地。創業百年の歴史を持つ。料理も好評。
sales_point_en: Situated in Konan Town, known as the birthplace of Koka-ryu Ninjutsu, this hot spring has a history of over 100 years. The cuisine is also highly praised.

name: 白滝温泉
sales_point: 琵琶湖の西側、蓬莱山に位置する温泉地。琵琶湖を一望でき、眺望が良い。
review_summary:
People say this cafe offers a wide variety of amenities, including a radon hot spring, a large sauna, delicious food, and a relaxing atmosphere with free coffee and manga.

Other reviews mention the bathing facilities can be neglected and staff can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: Located on the western side of Lake Biwa, near Mount Hōrai, this hot spring offers a great view of Lake Biwa.

name: 須賀谷温泉
sales_point: 小谷山の山麓に位置する温泉地。浅井長政などが湯治をしたと伝えられ歴史が永い。湖北史跡探勝の足場に好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen ryokan offers excellent, iron-rich hot springs and delicious meals featuring local Shiga Prefecture ingredients. They also highlight the kind and attentive staff, along with the quiet, relaxing atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the amenities can be lacking.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located at the foot of Mount Odani. It has a long history, with legends of figures like Nagamasa Azai visiting for healing. It is a great base for exploring historical sites in the Hokuriku region.

name: 長浜太閤温泉
sales_point: 琵琶湖の東岸に位置する温泉地。長浜城跡の豊公園内にある。豊臣秀吉公に初めて子供が産まれたことが由来で「子宝の湯」とも言われる。
review_summary: Guests mention this ryokan offers excellent food, including delicious Omi beef, and many rooms feature private hot tubs with beautiful views of Lake Biwa. They also highlight the exceptional hospitality and attentive staff, who provide thoughtful service and assistance with local transportation. Visitors appreciate the well-maintained facilities, including the onsen, and the high-quality amenities.
sales_point_en: Situated on the eastern shore of Lake Biwa, this hot spring is located within Toyokuni Park, the site of Nagahama Castle. It is also known as 'Childbirth Hot Spring' as it is said to be where Toyotomi Hideyoshi's first child was born.

name: びわ湖温泉
sales_point: 大津市街地の北部、琵琶湖南西岸に位置する温泉地。琵琶湖を一望でき、眺望が良い。
review_summary:
People say this cafe offers a wide variety of amenities, including a radon hot spring, a large sauna, delicious food, and a relaxing atmosphere with free coffee and manga.

Other reviews mention the bathing facilities can be neglected and staff can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: Located in the northern part of Otsu City, on the southwestern shore of Lake Biwa, this hot spring offers a stunning view of the lake.

name: マキノ白谷温泉
sales_point: マキノスキー場の北側に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。特に動脈硬化や高血圧などに効果が高いと言われる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring offers a unique radon spring experience with both indoor and outdoor baths, and many appreciate the availability of private baths. They also highlight the clean facilities, helpful staff, and convenient cashless payment options.

Some reviews mention the baths can be small and crowded.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located north of the Makino Ski Resort, in a quiet environment, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation. It is said to be particularly effective for arteriosclerosis and high blood pressure.

name: 宮乃温泉
sales_point: 甲賀の里、田園風景の中に位置する温泉地。甲賀忍びの湯、露天風呂もあり、くつろげる。甲賀探訪の基地に好適。
sales_point_en: Set in the rural landscape of Koka, this hot spring features Koka Ninja baths and outdoor baths, providing a relaxing experience. It is a great base for exploring Koka.
